name: Eugene Wu
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (1996-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026); Hurun China (2021-2026)
forbes_bio: Eugene Wu holds a stake in TS Financial Holding, Taiwan's fourth-largest financial holding company with nearly $260 billion in total assets.
TS Financial Holding was created through a merger of Tashin Holdings and Shin Kong Financial Holding in 2025.
Shin Kong and Tashin were founded by Eugene Wu and his billionaire brother, Thomas Wu, respectively.
Their late father, Wu Ho-Su, built a fortune in trading and textiles starting in the 1940s.

name: Cai Dongchen
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes real-time (former) (2023); Forbes annual (2018-2025); Hurun Global (2020-2026); Hurun China (2019-2026)
forbes_bio: Cai Dongchen is the chairman and CEO of CSPC Pharmaceutical Group.
CSPC's bulk drug products include vitamin C, antibiotics and caffeine.
The company's manufacturing facilities are located mainly in the eastern Chinese city of Shijiazhuang.
Cai holds a MBA degree from Nankai University.

name: Chen Fashu
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes real-time (former) (2024); Forbes annual (2007-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026); Hurun China (2005-2026)
forbes_bio: Chen Fashu chairs New Huadu Group, a holding company which he founded in 1998 after several business ventures including timber trading and retail.
Through New Huadu Group, Chen holds stakes in Yunnan Baiyao (a pharmaceutical company) and Longi Green Energy.
Chen became an avid investor after reaping a large return with stakes in Zijin Minging Group, a gold miner.
Chen is also on the board of Shanghai Pharmaceuticals Holding.
He is a native of China's Fujian Province, northeast of Hong Kong.

name: Gu Yuhua
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes real-time (former) (2023); Forbes annual (2017-2025)
forbes_bio: Gu Yuhua controls Jason Furniture (Hangzhou), which listed in Shanghai in October 2016.
He started his career at a sofa workshop that he opened in eastern Nantong in 1982.
Gu's son Gu Jiangsheng is Jason's chairman; another son, Gu Hailong, sits on the board.

name: Larry Tanenbaum
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2023-2025); Hurun Global (2024-2026)
forbes_bio: Larry Tanenbaum is the chairman of Maple Leaf Sports & Entertainment, which owns several sports franchises including the NBA's Toronto Raptors, the NHL's Toronto Maple Leafs and MLS' Toronto FC.
In 1968, he graduated from Cornell University with a degree in Economics.
Tanenbaum's company, Kilmer Van Nostrand, operates in number of industries like infrastructure, electronics, publishing, food processing, gaming and more.
The Tanenbaum family acquired the business in the 1950s.
forbes_facts: Tanenbaum is a board member of the Hockey Hall of Fame in Toronto.

name: Cheng Xue
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes real-time (former) (2022); Forbes annual (2015-2025); Hurun Global (2015-2026); Hurun China (2014-2026); Hurun Self-Made Women (2017-2025)
forbes_bio: Cheng Xue is the vice chairwoman and CEO of Foshan Haitian Flavoring & Food Company, one of the largest makers of condiments in China.
She joined the company in 1990 and previously served as its director of corporate planning and vice president.
Cheng owns more than 12% of the company, which is chaired by fellow billionaire Pang Kang.

name: Phillip Frost
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2006-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026)
forbes_bio: A long-time health care investor, inventor and founder, Phillip Frost now runs diagnostics-maker Opko Health.
Frost joined Key Pharmaceuticals in 1972, reformulated its asthma drug and sold the company in 1986 for $836 million.
Frost founded Ivax, a generic drugmaker, in 1987. He sold it to Teva Pharmaceuticals for $7.6 billion in 2005.
In 2018, the SEC accused him of participating in a "pump-and-dump" scheme that generated over $27 million from unlawful stock sales.
Frost denied the allegations in a personal statement. He settled with the SEC in  2018 without admitting or denying the allegations.
forbes_facts: Born during the Great Depression, Frost is the third son of a shoe-store owner from South Philadelphia.
Frost and his wife, who have no children, have signed the Giving Pledge and have donated more than $130 million to the University of Miami.

name: Sylvia Stroeher
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2012-2025)
forbes_bio: In 2003, Sylvia Stroeher netted over $1 billion when her family sold 80% of hair-care group Wella AG to Procter & Gamble.
In 1927, her great-grandfather Franz bought the rights to a process that used hot curlers and chemicals to put long-lasting waves into women's hair.
Sylvia and her husband, a former nurse, have a renowned collection of contemporary German art that includes works by Baselitz, Immendorff and Kiefer.
Part of the collection is housed in the Museum Kueppersmuehle in Duisburg, Germany.
An extension to the museum by star architect Pierre de Meuron opened in 2020.
forbes_facts: In 2013, Sylvia helped struggling German publishing house Suhrkamp by paying writers' remuneration for some time; she now sits on its supervisory board.

name: Assaf Rappaport
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2024-2025); Hurun Global (2025-2026); Hurun Unicorn founders (2021-2025)
forbes_bio: Assaf Rappaport cofounded Israeli cloud security business Wiz and owned a 10% stake in the company.
Google's parent company Alphabet acquired Wiz for $32 billion in cash in March 2026.
Wiz software scans storage providers such as Amazon Web Services and Microsoft Azure to flag and prioritize security risks.
The company's revenue surpassed $100 million in 2023, when the founders began their "suicide plan" of hiring fast, raising funds and targeting top-of-market corporations.
Wiz customers include Fox, Morgan Stanley and LVMH, whose billionaire CEO wrote the unicorn a personal check.

name: Pan Sutong
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2021); Forbes annual (2015-2020); Hurun Global (2014-2021); Hurun China (2019-2021)
forbes_bio: Pan Sutong chairs investment conglomerate Goldin Group, which has assets in consumer electronics, wine, financial services and property.
He took his Hong Kong-listed Goldin Properties private in August 2017.
The developer's flagship project is Goldin Metropolitan in Tianjin; it is centered on a 117-story skyscraper. It also has an 890,000 sqm polo club.
Born in China, Pan moved to the U.S. at age 13 before relocating to Hong Kong at age 21.
forbes_facts: Pan founded Matsunichi Colour Display Monitor in 1993. The consumer electronics group Matsunichi is Goldin's founding business.
An avid fan of polo, he was elected vice president of the Federation of International Polo in 2012.
In 2011 he acquired 40-acre Sloan Estate Winery in Napa Valley for US$40 million.

name: Art Levinson
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2022-2025); Hurun Global (2024-2026); SEC insider holdings (2026)
forbes_bio: Art Levinson has been chairman of the board of Apple since 2011; he owns more shares of Apple than CEO Tim Cook.
He was the CEO of successful biotech firm Genentech from 1995 to 2009 and served as its chairman from 1999 to 2014.
Levinson was also on the board of Google from 2004 to 2009. A few years later, he was named CEO of Calico, a health company created by Google.
He has authored or co-authored dozens of scientific papers and been named an inventor on 11 U.S. patents.
He has a Ph.D in biochemical sciences from Princeton.

name: Aras Agalarov
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2025); Forbes annual (2008-2021); Hurun Global (2014-2026)
forbes_bio: Aras Agalarov began his business journey bringing premium goods to Russia. He later pivoted to the development of luxury retail centers.
Now Agalarov owns more than ten large shopping centers, a concert hall, oceanarium and exhibition complex.
His company Crocus Group was the general contractor for two stadiums that hosted the 2018 FIFA World Cup matches.
Crocus City Hall hosted the Miss Universe finals in 2013. Donald Trump attended the ceremony and met with the Agalarovs.
Agalarov's son, Emin, helps his father in business; he moonlights as a pop singer.
Emin had to cancel his tour in the USA in 2018 due to prosecutor Mueller's investigation.
forbes_facts: According to Donald Trump Jr., the Agalarovs arranged the 2016 meeting at Trump Tower between Trump campaign officials and Russian lobbyists. They deny involvement.
Emin Agalarov was married to Azerbaijan president Ilham Aliyev's daughter, but they divorced in 2015.
